Welcome!
--

Hello! My name is Kate Bierwagen and I am currently a third year student at UCSB studying Environmental Studies. This website serves as a portfolio of my academic achievements as well as my personal achievements. 



Research
--

I am currently a Scientific Diver for Santa Barbara Coastal LTER and have worked in the Caselle Lab at UCSB where I examined video footage of Rockfish species. I am very interested in fisheries management and exploring the role science can play in creating sustainable ocean solutions.
